name: Moving-pulse lead with delayed vibrato (mid sustain)

scoreOwned: gate-off timing: without a gate-off cell before the next note the next note connects with no new envelope attack (songs/pink-panther/README.md native tempo-1 policy; in recipes the converter writes the cell, scripts/arrange-sidwizard.py gate_off_tick)

pitchSettlesAfterUpdates.detail: stock Extra at tempo 1 sets only the frequency high byte on a new note's first frame (reproduced: E4 first sounded about 75 cents flat), docs/songs/fuer-elise-native.md

character.summary: Wide moving-pulse program with delayed vibrato as in version 1, with sustain lowered to 6 and release 4; the waveform table ends after setting the body pitch so vibrato can develop on held notes.

waveforms.detail: program data songs/fuer-elise-sidwizard.json instruments.melody-pulse: wave table control bytes $41 = pulse + gate; frame1 $09 is the TEST frame and sounds no waveform

attack.detail: envelope attack nibble 0 = 2 ms (datasheet rate); spec thresholds hard <= 8 ms, medium <= 24 ms, soft >= 38 ms

body.detail: pulse table [84 00 00][20 20 00][20 e0 00] jump 1: set width $400, 32 executions of +$20, 32 of -$20, loop; documented as the bank sweep $400-$800

release.detail: envelope release nibble 4 = 114 ms full-scale (datasheet rate); spec thresholds cut <= 24 ms, short <= 114 ms, medium <= 300 ms, long >= 750 ms

level.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; AC RMS dBFS over the first 250 ms and over 1.0-1.9 s of the note

brightness.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; spectral centroid divided by the fundamental over 0-60 ms and 50-550 ms (pure triangle about 1.0)

motion.detail: bank write log: pulse width 1024-2048 while gated
bank trace: pitch stable through tick 111, first vibrato change at tick 112, then cycles 5578-5650 around 5614

avoid.condition: quiet ballad whose brief asks for a tender, intimate, wistful character: the pulse lead with width motion and delayed vibrato was rejected as too loud and offensive in the joint first palette; fit is brief-dependent, instrument not isolated

provenance.rights: MIT (original project instrument definition, no upstream preset bytes copied; the arrangement it is embedded in carries separate terms)
